topics.objective: Apply gender and number agreement to descriptive adjectives and place them correctly before or after the noun using the BAGS rule.
topics.spacy_pattern:
pattern = [
    {"POS": "DET", "OP": "?"},
    {"POS": "ADJ", "OP": "*"},  # Pre-posed BAGS adjectives
    {"POS": "NOUN"},
    {"POS": "ADJ", "OP": "*"},  # Post-posed regular adjectives
]
